targets.expr: avg by (instance,type) (rate(mongodb_mongod_op_latencies_latency_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set"}[$__interval]) / (rate(mongodb_mongod_op_latencies_ops_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set"}[$__interval]) > 0) or irate(mongodb_mongod_op_latencies_latency_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set"}[5m]) / (irate(mongodb_mongod_op_latencies_ops_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set"}[5m]) > 0))

panels.description: Ratio of Documents returned or Index entries scanned / full documents scanned"

targets.expr:
(sum(rate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_query_executor_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set", state="scanned"}[$__interval])) by (instance)/
sum(rate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_query_executor_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set", state="scanned_objects"}[$__interval])) by (instance) 
or
sum(irate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_query_executor_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set", state="scanned"}[5m])) by (instance)/
sum(irate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_query_executor_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set", state="scanned_objects"}[5m])) by (instance))

sum(rate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_document_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set", state="returned"}[$__interval]))  by (instance)/
sum(rate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_query_executor_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set", state="scanned_objects"}[$__interval]))  by (instance) 
or
sum(irate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_document_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set", state="returned"}[5m]))  by (instance)/
sum(irate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_query_executor_total{namespace="$namespace", instance=~"$data_set", state="scanned_objects"}[5m]))  by (instance)
